name: trailtrace
description: TrailTrace — predictive analytics foundation for cybercrime financial intelligence (SIH 26184). Synthetic demo only.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @trailtrace/api" "npm run dev -w @trailtrace/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trailtrace/api && npm run build -w @trailtrace/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trailtrace/shared && npm run typecheck -w @trailtrace/api && npm run typecheck -w @trailtrace/web
